profile.name: Parham Janjan
profile.tagline: Building intelligent systems and digital experiences.
profile.intro: I’m an AI-focused developer who enjoys turning complex ideas into useful, thoughtfully designed software. My work spans machine learning, natural language processing, full-stack development, and real-time web applications.
about: I’m interested in the practical side of artificial intelligence: understanding data, building useful models, and integrating intelligent capabilities into real products.
Alongside AI and machine learning, I build full-stack applications and interactive web experiences. I value experimentation, clean implementation, and learning by shipping real projects.

projects.name: Hesabgar
projects.description: A messaging platform combined with a suite of digital tools and online examination features, with AI-powered capabilities.
projects.details: Designed as a multi-purpose digital platform that brings communication, learning tools, and online assessments together.

projects.name: Sentiment Analysis
projects.description: A text analysis project focused on identifying sentiment and extracting useful signals from written content.
projects.details: Explores NLP workflows for turning unstructured text into interpretable sentiment insights.

projects.name: Topic Modeling for Tickets
projects.description: An intelligent approach to discovering recurring themes and patterns across customer support tickets.
projects.details: Combines semantic representations with lexical retrieval techniques, including BGE-M3 embeddings and BM25, to support ticket exploration and categorization.

projects.name: Tumour Classification
projects.description: A machine learning project focused on tumour classification.
projects.details: A classification-focused project exploring how machine learning can be applied to a medical-data problem. It is a research and software project, not a clinical diagnostic tool.
